player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: እንቅስቃሴ መስጫ አይነት አልበቃም. '[X 4]' ወይም '[O 2]' አይነት ይጠቀሙ.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: ልክ ያልሆነ የክፍያ ቁጥር: {cell} ከ 0 እስከ 8 መሆን አለበት.
invalid_move.already_occupied: ልክ ያልሆነ እንቅስቃሴ። ህዋስ {cell} ቀድሞውኑ ተይዟል።

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their symbol ({mark}) in cell {cell}
